patterns_found.name: Double Bottom
patterns_found.evidence: Price formed a swing low near 1725, rallied to approximately 1830, then formed a second swing low near 1775-1800 before rallying back to test the 1830-1850 resistance zone.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Left shoulder low near 1800, lower head low near 1725, and right shoulder forming near 1775-1800. Neckline resistance around 1830-1850.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from lower lows/lower highs to higher lows after the 1725 swing low. Price is approaching prior swing high resistance.
